title: RFC 9110: HTTP Semantics
excerpt: Defines HTTP request/response semantics, intermediaries, methods, status codes, and the protocol properties used when drawing distributed request paths.

title: RFC 9111: HTTP Caching
excerpt: Defines cache storage, freshness, validation, invalidation, shared/private behavior, and security considerations for HTTP caches.

title: RFC 6585: Additional HTTP Status Codes
excerpt: Defines 429 Too Many Requests and the optional Retry-After response signal used by rate-limited clients.

title: PostgreSQL Documentation: Indexes
excerpt: Documents index types, multicolumn and partial indexes, index-only scans, and the operational tradeoff between faster access and write/storage cost.

title: PostgreSQL Documentation: Warm Standby and Streaming Replication
excerpt: Documents standby replication, streaming behavior, replication lag, failover, and synchronous replication tradeoffs.

title: PostgreSQL Documentation: Table Partitioning
excerpt: Documents range, list, and hash partitioning, pruning, maintenance benefits, and constraints that guide partition-key selection.

title: Caching Challenges and Strategies
excerpt: Explains local and external caches, cache failure modes, request coalescing, load amplification, hit rate, and downstream protection.

title: Timeouts, Retries, and Backoff with Jitter
excerpt: Explains bounded timeouts, retry amplification, exponential backoff, jitter, idempotency, and retry placement in layered services.

title: Avoiding Overload in Distributed Systems by Putting the Smaller Service in Control
excerpt: Describes admission control, load shedding, queue bounds, client behavior, and techniques that prevent overload from becoming an outage cascade.

title: Google SRE Book: Load Balancing at the Frontend
excerpt: Explains DNS and virtual-IP load balancing, health-aware routing, traffic distribution, and the operational constraints of frontend balancing.

title: Google SRE Book: Service Level Objectives
excerpt: Defines SLIs, SLOs, SLAs, user-centered indicators, percentile-based latency, and error budgets as operational decision tools.

title: Google SRE Book: Monitoring Distributed Systems
excerpt: Defines black-box and white-box monitoring and frames latency, traffic, errors, and saturation as core service signals.

title: Amazon SQS Visibility Timeout
excerpt: Documents in-flight messages, redelivery, at-least-once behavior, visibility timeout, and the need for idempotent consumers.

title: In Search of an Understandable Consensus Algorithm
excerpt: Presents Raft consensus through leader election, log replication, safety constraints, membership changes, and majority quorum reasoning.

title: Brewer's Conjecture and the Feasibility of Consistent, Available, Partition-Tolerant Web Services
excerpt: Formalizes the consistency, availability, and network-partition model behind CAP and proves the limitation for asynchronous networks.

title: Using Architectural Decision Records to Streamline Technical Decision-Making
excerpt: Defines an ADR workflow that records context, considered options, decisions, consequences, status, and ownership for durable technical reasoning.
